messages:
Iris W: Quick idea: introduce a \"migration debt\" metric per-route to drive deprecation UX. It'd estimate remaining effort/cost to move to v2 and power console banners + billing previews. Thoughts?
Don C: Love the metric name. What inputs? token volume, number of endpoints, eval failure rate?
Iris W: Baseline: recent 7d token volume, percent of requests pinned to v1, and a lightweight quality delta (v2_pass_rate - v1_pass_rate) from our evals. Combine into a single score 0-100.
Maya P: For routing: use the score to decide routing aggressiveness: score>70 -> auto-prefer v2 (95%), 30-70 -> gentle split (80/20), <30 -> keep current. Also show a console banner with score and one-click preview.
Console UX: Banner copy suggestion: \"Migration debt: 82 — we recommend switching to v2 to reduce latency & cost. Preview impact.\" Modal shows projected token shift, bill delta, and example diff in outputs.
Iris W: Telemetry: tag requests with `migration_debt_bucket` (high/med/low) and sample 1/100 requests with full payload diffs for later evaluation. Avoid high-cardinality tags.
Don C: Enforcement: when we flip defaults, we still allow v1 fallback but cap it by a per-route throttle: throttle_tokens = baseline * 0.15. Return `HTTP 429 {\"error\":\"migration_debt_limit\",\"hint\":\"Enable v2 or request extension\"}` and header `X-Migration-Debt-Remaining`.
Maya P: Rollout UX: add a preview-mode in console that simulates routing for 24h using current traffic and shows which requests would have hit v1. Useful for customers to validate. Provide `POST /preview/routes/{id}?window=24h`.
telemetry-bot: Note: sampling diffs means we need a small pipeline for payload diffs. Label samples with `diff_sample=true` and route to long-term storage only.
finance-bot: Make sure modal shows estimated monthly cost delta. We should recalc nightly for tenants in preview or soft-rollout.
Iris W: Also add event `migration_debt.action` with actions: previewed, forced_migrate, extension_requested. We'll use that to measure adoption.
Don C: Runbook: if v2 error-rate jumps >0.4% absolute in 15m for the cohort, pause auto-prefers and notify infra. If >5% tenants hit migration debt throttle in 10m, open an ops ticket.
Maya P: UX detail: include an inline toggle in the banner: \"Prefer v2 for this route (recommended)\" and a small link \"Why this score?\" that opens a breakdown of tokens, pins, and eval delta.
Console UX: I'll mock the banner + modal with three copy levels: friendly, technical, and executive. Will include bill delta and a sample of changed outputs for transparency.
Iris W: Action items: Don -> throttle API + headers; Maya -> preview API + console flow; Console UX -> banner + modal mocks; Telemetry -> sampling plan + `migration_debt` tag; Finance -> nightly recalcs. Sync tomorrow 11:00 for go/no-go.
